home.hero_desc: Manage registration, participants, committee, payments, attendance, cards, and certificates in one integrated secure and modern platform.
home.main_feature_subtitle: All your event management needs in one integrated platform
home.feature_1_desc: Easy and fast online event registration system. Participants can register anytime, anywhere, with digitally recorded process.
home.feature_2_desc: Manage participants and committee centrally. Import/export data, search filters, and complete role management records.
home.feature_3_desc: Generate digital participant cards with QR code. Customizable design, print ready, and directly accessible by participants digitally.
home.feature_4_desc: Automatically generate digital certificates for all participants. Professional design, digital verification, and automatic delivery.
home.feature_5_desc: Attendance using QR code scanner or manual. Attendance data recorded real-time and exportable for reports.
home.feature_6_desc: All event activities recorded digitally: registration, payment, attendance, certificates, and documentation. Data is secure and accessible anytime.
home.workflow_subtitle: Easy steps to manage your event digitally
home.step_1_desc: Complete name, date, location, quota, and other details
home.step_2_desc: Activate digital registration, data recorded instantly
home.step_3_desc: Participant & committee management, digital cards and certificates
home.step_4_desc: QR code attendance, all activities recorded and exportable
